descriptions.private: Leave the noise ashore. Enjoy a private trip along the coast, see Barcelona from a new perspective and share the Mediterranean at your own pace.

routeText: Your trip follows the Barcelona coast. The skipper agrees the route and any stops according to your duration, sea conditions and what is possible on the day.
sunsetNote: Departure is arranged around sunset and varies with the season and your chosen duration.
sunriseNote: Departure is arranged around sunrise and varies with the season and your chosen duration.
faqs: Is the boat private or will we share with other guests?
Your trip is private: the boat is reserved for your group, with a skipper on board. We do not sell places to other groups on your departure.
Do I need a boating licence?
No licence or sailing experience is needed. JimBoats experiences include a skipper who handles navigation and adjusts the route to sea conditions.
How much does it cost and how long can we sail?

Day trip: 1–6 hours. Sunrise and sunset: 2–6 hours. Romantic experience: 1–4 hours. Prices are per boat for the selected duration, not per person. You can extend your trip up to the maximum for your experience, subject to availability.
What is included and what costs extra?

The price includes private use of the boat, skipper, fuel and insurance. No licence is needed. Extras such as paddleboarding, eFoil or a photographer are booked separately, subject to availability, and added to the boat price.
How do I book?

Open an experience, choose your duration and continue to booking to check the date, departure time, group size and total. Review the conditions before confirming. For special requests, contact us on WhatsApp first.
Where do we board and how do we get there?
We depart from Port Olímpic, at Moll de Xaloc, Pantalan 5, Barcelona. Use the map and directions link on this page. Confirm the exact meeting point with JimBoats and allow time to board comfortably.
How many guests can join? Can children come?
Every experience welcomes up to 6 guests, including children. Let us know the ages of younger children and any boarding assistance you may need when arranging your booking.
How do the daytime, sunrise and sunset trips differ?

A daytime trip explores the coast in daylight; sunrise and sunset experiences are timed around the first and last light. Departure times for these two experiences vary with the date and your chosen duration.
When is the best time of year for a boat trip in Barcelona?

Spring and summer bring longer daylight hours. Autumn and winter offer a different atmosphere and an extra layer is useful. Departures depend on availability and, above all, sea conditions on the day.
What should we bring?

Bring sunscreen, sunglasses, comfortable shoes and an extra layer for the breeze. If you would like a swim stop, bring swimwear and a towel and ask us in advance: stops depend on the duration and sea conditions.
Can we celebrate a birthday, anniversary or proposal?

Yes, talk to us about a private trip for your special occasion. The romantic experience includes the decorations shown in the photos. We have several decoration options; contact us before booking to discuss any special requests.
What happens in bad weather or if I need to cancel?

The skipper assesses whether it is possible to sail or the trip needs adapting. Changes, cancellations and any refunds depend on your booking conditions. Read them before confirming and contact JimBoats promptly if your plans change.

reviewsTranslations.emma: From the moment we stepped on board, Victor made the whole experience feel personal, relaxed and completely bespoke.
reviewsTranslations.asante: He was friendly, professional, and made the experience feel easy and relaxed from start to finish.
reviewsTranslations.stefania: jumping into the ocean, using the paddleboard, and relaxing in the sun while listening to our own music.
reviewsTranslations.adam: the boat was well stocked with drinks and lovely ham. He even let us use the speaker on board.
reviewsTranslations.kateryna: We went in the evening to watch the drone show from the water, and it was an amazing experience.
reviewsTranslations.alina: We were celebrating my sister‘s bachelorette party and it’s a great idea to do so!
reviewsTranslations.megan: We just had a 2 hour private boat trip as a group of six with Victor and LOVED it.

victorBio: Víctor grew up in Barcelona. A co-owner and skipper, he has sailed along the coast and between the mainland and the islands, and has experience anchoring in local waters. He particularly enjoys showing guests Barceloneta at sunset. His qualifications include Capitán de Yate and PPER.
davidBio: David is a co-founder and skipper. He prepares the boat, organises bookings and takes guests out to sea. Before leaving, he checks the wind and swell again to choose the route. His favourite moment is leaving the harbour at sunrise. He holds Capitán de Yate and PPER qualifications.
